tasks.label: 📊 Phase 72: Quick Status Check
args: Write-Host '📊 Phase 72 - RAG/KAG Status Check' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '1. AST Knowledge Base:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (Test-Path 'reports/latest/project-knowledge-base.tree.json') { $kb = Get-Item 'reports/latest/project-knowledge-base.tree.json'; Write-Host "   ✅ Found: $($kb.Name) ($([math]::Round($kb.Length/1MB, 2)) MB)" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '   ⏳ Not generated yet' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '2. Qdrant Collection:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $qdrant = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:6333/collections/phase72_ast_knowledge_base' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host "   ✅ Collection exists: $($qdrant.result.points_count) vectors" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '   ⏳ Not loaded yet' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '3. Recommendations:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (Test-Path 'reports/latest/ast-rag-recommendations.md') { Write-Host '   ✅ Generated' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '   ⏳ Not generated yet' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''
